description: ⚠️ EXPERIMENTAL / orientation-only. Approximate population-adjusted indirect comparison using summary-level statistics (mean, SD per covariate). True MAIC/STC per NICE DSU TSD 18 requires individual patient data (IPD) for one trial. This tool inflates the SE of a Bucher indirect comparison based on covariate imbalance (MAIC-style ESS penalty) and applies a simple linear adjustment based on standardized mean differences (STC-style). Point estimates should be interpreted as approximate — not submission-ready. For a definitive analysis, use IPD with an outcome regression model.

ai_disclosure_level.description: AI assistance disclosure level. "off" = no disclosure; "standard" = default (model/tools/sources/date + human-review reminder); "submission" = adds ISPOR ELEVATE-GenAI citation. Default is tool-specific.

decisions.description: Methodological decisions made in conversation (source selection, comparator choice, screening criteria, model structure...). Each entry records the choice, the rationale (why), alternatives rejected, and who decided. Embedded in the audit trail Decision Log and, when a project is supplied, appended to wiki/decisions.md for cross-session recall. Tools never invent decisions — only pass what the user made or confirmed. Design log #52.

decided_by.description: Who made the decision — mark honestly

references.description: DOI/PMID/URL — recorded verbatim, rendered as unverified unless verified via utils.verify_citations

effect_modifiers.description: Names of covariates that are effect modifiers (must appear in both trials' covariates)

index_trial.description: Trial with data to be reweighted (the trial for which you want to adjust)

effect.description: Point estimate (HR, OR, RR, or MD)

method.description: auto (default): MAIC when >=2 modifiers and N>=50, else STC

outcome_name.description: Name of the outcome being compared (e.g., 'HbA1c change')

target_trial.description: Trial whose population is the matching target

name: evidence.population_adjusted
